text: さいきんは　ふんか　してない　みたいだし　やまのぼりを　たのしんで　きたら？

structure.jp: さいきんは　ふんか　してない　みたいだし
structure.en: it doesn't seem to have erupted lately, so

structure.jp: やまのぼりを　たのしんで　きたら？
structure.en: why not go and enjoy a mountain climb?

patterns.name: 〜たら (suggestion)
patterns.span: たのしんで　きたら？
patterns.explanation: たら with a rising voice at the end is a friendly suggestion: 'why don't you'. たのしんで くる is 'go, enjoy, and come back'. たのしんで きたら？ = 'why not go and enjoy it?'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: してない　みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ means 'it seems, it looks like'. してない is the shortened していない. ふんか してない みたいだ = 'it seems it hasn't been erupting'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as a reason for what comes next: 'and so'. みたいだし = 'it seems so, so'.
